faqs.a: Pick an outfit, choose your hours or days, and pay securely. We deliver it fresh-cleaned to your door (or you pick it up from the lender), and collect it when your rental ends. No laundry, no stress.

faqs.q: What if my outfit doesn't fit?
faqs.a: Every listing shows exact measurements. If it still doesn't fit on arrival, tell us within 1 hour and we'll swap it or refund the rental fee in full.
Yes, 100%. Your deposit is held (not charged) and released within 48 hours of the lender confirming a safe return.
Our partner studios professionally clean every piece between rentals, so you always get it fresh. The cleaning fee is shown upfront — never a surprise.

faqs.q: What happens if something gets damaged?
faqs.a: Small accidents happen. ReWear Damage Protection covers minor stains, loose threads and missing buttons. For bigger damage, we mediate fairly using check-in and check-out photos.

faqs.q: How much can I earn as a lender?
faqs.a: Lenders keep 85% of every rental. Most active lenders with 5–10 occasion pieces earn ₹8,000–₹25,000 a month, and you can pause listings anytime.
